verdict.rationale: Phaser's docs say full TypeScript definitions ship in the package's types folder and that editors such as VSCode detect them automatically. That gives a coding agent's editor typed API definitions to attach to. The docs do not spell out completions, diagnostics or navigation, and there is no official language server. missing for 10: explicit documentation of completion/diagnostic/navigation behavior, an official LSP, independent hands-on corroboration that the bundled types are complete and accurate.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the scripting language has first-class machine tooling — an official language server (LSP) or typed API definitions a coding agent's editor can attach to for completions, diagnostics, and navigation
